:[Cueball is looking down and pointing with a finger towards the floor in front of Miss Lenhart who is facing him. Behind her is a picture on the wall showing seven sedimentary layers above each other, assuming the top of the picture is air. Each layer has a different texture than the ones it borders but two are as white as the air at the top, including the bottom-most layer.]
:Cueball: So you're saying that if we tear up these layers, there's hardwood flooring under here?
:Miss Lenhart: ...I mean, sort of...

:[Caption below the panel:]
:Home remodelers learn about the Carboniferous
